description.zh: 表示是否根据指定的数据库连接ID来进行kill操作。默认为false，根据代理链接ID来进行KILL对应的所有数据库连接；
description.en: Indicates whether to perform the KILL operation based on the specified database connection ID. The default value is false, which means the KILL operation is performed based on the proxy link ID to terminate all corresponding database connections.
The ID of the OceanBase cluster.
The list of sessions to close.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro batch-kill-process-list --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --session-list ProxySessId_:_752113700739156671_,_SessionId_:3221555062,_ServerIp_:_10.000.00.000 --tenant-id t33h8y08k0000 --by-ob-session-id true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro BatchKillProcessList --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t33h8y08k0000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SessionList 'ProxySessId_:_752113700739156671_,_SessionId_:3221555062,_ServerIp_:_10.000.00.000' --ByObSessionId true
